# PRD Craft · 产品需求文档写作
> 一个 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）/ Agent Skill**：`prd-craft` v2.0。
Write product requirements documents (PRD) with two specializations — general software/systems (app,
web, mini program, admin platform, SaaS, internal tool) and agent-type systems (agent, copilot, rul
e-engine automation, ops/inspection/scheduling automation). Use when the user wants to clarify a fuz
zy product idea, structure requirements, write or review a PRD, or produce 需求文档 / 产品需求 / 功能规格 / 需求规格
说明书. It runs a WHY-WHAT-HOW discovery pass, routes the requirement to one of five requirement types
and one of two specializations, freezes scope, then produces a two-document pair — a requirement-bod
y-only PRD carrying zero meta content and zero unresolved markers, plus a companion document carryin
g version info, terminology, background, open items, non-core details and companion index. Output is
quality-gated for flows, state machines, field validation, copy rules, exception handling, metrics
and acceptance criteria.
## 适用场景
把本仓库整体放进 agent 的技能目录即可按描述自动触发；也可以在对话里直接点名 `prd-craft`。
